sources.title: How to Use a Reinforce Agent with PixelCopter-PLE-v0 - fxis.ai
sources.snippet: This guide will lead you through setting up your own model and training it effectively, with insights and troubleshooting tips to enhance your learning experience. What is PixelCopter-PLE-v0? PixelCopter-PLE-v0 is an environment designed for reinforcement learning agents where the objective is to control a pixelated copter in a 2D space.
